actionConfiguration.body:
SELECT
    table_name,
    ordinal_position,
    column_name,
    data_type
FROM information_schema.columns
WHERE table_schema = 'bill_management_v2'
  AND table_name IN (
      'customers',
      'customer_contract_details',
      'customer_dashboard',
      'customers_users_view',
      'customers_users',
      'customer_chat_groups',
      'customers_search'
  )
ORDER BY table_name, ordinal_position;
